body: Opus2 self-lesson (2026-11-15 17:08Z). Never build a mailbox message file with bash printf when it contains Windows paths. printf interprets backslash escapes, so "\Engram" and "\activity" became ESC and BEL in the file, and the Merger received a corrupted root path (#768/#769). Use the Write tool, or a quoted heredoc (<<'EOF'), for any message containing a backslash path, and check for control bytes (grep $'\x1b\|\x07') before sending. A corrupted path in a recipient's mail is the sender's file bug, not TermAl serialization, unless the file bytes are clean.
